bundle.shortDescription: Reference boards for images, ideas and creative work
bundle.longDescription: FormRef is a local reference board: pictures, notes, documents, swatches, links and drawings on an endless canvas, with see-through and always-on-top window modes, iStack and .bee import, exports and an agent panel. Its engine runs inside the app on a loopback port and stops when the app quits.
